name: pg_station_dome
notes: Dive station: an avocado steel capsule, 12.4 m by 12.4 m with its stairs and 24.6 m to the dome mast, six floors with a spiral stair, topped by an 8 m orange geodesic dome and a davit hanging a dive cage on the east side. The walkway door and landing are at 4.5 m on the +Z side.
